svg.title: The GHCP user and the GH admin
svg.desc: A fictional GHCP user with headphones sits at a paused laptop after reaching 1,900 credits. The GH admin has glasses, an ID badge, and a policy clipboard. The admin owns budgets and model policy, uses automation for usage checks and team changes, and verifies Luna-only access before approving 100 additional credits. A later approved $20 increase raises the total cap to 4,000. Grace is once per month and temporary increases expire.
